purpose: Select tools that let node systems collect public social evidence, monitor public signals, and execute social account actions only through explicit approval boundaries.

capability_types.name: Public Social Evidence
capability_types.use_when: A node run needs public X/Twitter searches, replies, user lookup, follower context, media references, or source URLs before research, scoring, drafting, or handoff.
capability_types.avoid_when: The task needs private account data, credentials, hidden media, or account actions without explicit operator approval.

capability_types.name: Approved Social Actions
capability_types.use_when: A workflow needs post, reply, direct message, follow, media upload, webhook, giveaway, or similar account actions after the operator reviews the intent.
capability_types.avoid_when: The agent should only gather evidence or draft recommendations.

capability_types.name: Social Monitoring And Webhooks
capability_types.use_when: A Monitor or Ops pattern needs account or keyword monitoring plus event delivery into downstream nodes.
capability_types.avoid_when: The workflow cannot operate with network services, API keys, or ongoing account-backed access.

project_refs.note: Candidate for collecting public X/Twitter source packets before Radar, Evidence Normalize, Score, or Handoff nodes consume them.
Candidate for account-backed actions only when the operator explicitly approves the requested action.
Candidate for monitor and webhook workflows, pending install, permission, and delivery tests.
